description:
This beautifully presented three-bedroom apartment is situated in the highly sought-after Kelvindale area of Glasgow's fashionable West End. Finished to an exceptional standard throughout, the property offers a bright and welcoming atmosphere, complemented by stylish interiors and a high-quality finish. This block of flats sits at the end of a terrace and benefits from larger gardens that wrap around the side. span>

To the rear, the apartment enjoys peaceful open views across the lush woodlands bordering the banks of the Forth and Clyde Canal and onto Dawsholm Park, creating a tranquil setting while remaining within easy reach of the vibrant amenities of the West End. Access to public transport is excellent, with the Kelvindale train station just 100 yards away, offering regular services to the city centre.

Accommodation: clean and tidy communal stairwell, reception hallway, lounge, dining room or 3rd bedroom, two double bedrooms and finally a contemporary bathroom with an over-bath shower.

Externally, there is a private deck and shared gardens.
Specification: gas central heating, double glazing and a security entry system.
